title: Prohibited signs.
officialText: No illuminated business or advertising sign shall be permitted on any protective structure required by this section. Other than as specified in Sections 3301.9 or 3301.10 there shall be no sign, information, pictorial representation, or any business or advertising messages posted on a sidewalk shed, bridge, fence, or other protective structure listed in this section that is erected at the construction or demolition site.
